# Peak ESG — student client

Published at <https://nicolamisani.com/peak-esg/>.

**Generated — do not edit here.** Every file in this repository is written by
`publish.py` in the Peak ESG project folder. Edit the originals there and run
`python3 publish.py`, or your change will be overwritten by the next publish.

The client talks to the Firestore session the instructor's Mac is driving.
Nothing in this repository is a secret: `firebase-config.js` only identifies
the project, and access is governed by the Firestore rules.

- `?net=local` — offline mode, one browser only, for a solo run-through.
- `?fresh` — forget the game saved on this device.
